skills.name: eno-search-listings
skills.description: Search live listings on eno.vn, Vietnam's marketplace for expats and locals (apartments and rooms, motorbikes and cars, electronics, furniture, jobs, services), with prices in VND and a link to each listing. Use when someone wants to rent, buy or find something or a job in Vietnam. No account needed.

skills.name: eno-shop-listings
skills.description: Manage one eno.vn shop's listings from an AI agent through eno.vn's Partner MCP server: create, edit, mark sold or hidden, delete, bulk-create from a stock list, and sync with your own catalogue by externalId. Use when a seller wants to put their stock on eno.vn or keep it up to date.

skills.name: eno-shop-analytics
skills.description: Read an eno.vn shop's views and leads, and manage its webhooks, from an AI agent through eno.vn's Partner MCP server. Use when a seller asks how their listings are doing on eno.vn or wants their own system told when a listing changes.
